messages.生体材料(特殊充電)の威力を3まで育てて出血付与を強化し、マイナス効果を5種重ね: A Bleed attacker that grows the special Charge, Corpus Ingredient, to 3 Potency to improve Bleed application, then triggers S2's follow-up against enemies carrying 5 types of negative effect.
messages.生体材料と「作品名:ティビア」: 常時パッシブ「生涯の作品、ティビア」により、ダ: **Corpus Ingredient and Artwork: Tibia**: Through the always-active passive Magnum Opus: Tibia, Count increases by 5 at the end of a skill that dealt damage (+3 if the target dies). Each time he spends a cumulative 10 Count, he gains 1 Corpus Ingredient Potency. At Potency 2, he gains Artwork: Tibia, activating +1 Base Power (the Potency 1+ effect) and +10% damage against enemies with Bleed (the 2+ effect) at that point; at 3, +1 to Bleed Potency and Count inflicted is added. At Potency 1, Tibia has no effect yet.
messages.S3「ティビアのメロディー-解体されたものが解体されていないものを解体すること」: **S3 — Tibia's Melody - Anatomization of the Unanatomized by the Anatomized**: With at least 10 Corpus Ingredient Count, spends up to 20 to enhance itself, making all Coins Unbreakable Coins. Attack Weight also increases with Corpus Ingredient Potency. Because it spends a lot at once, it is a way to reach Potency 3.
messages.S2「材料獲得-血で沐浴するオブジェ」の追撃: 対象のマイナス効果の種類に応じて: **S2 Gather Ingredient - Blood-bathed Objet's follow-up**: Deals more damage based on the number of different negative effects on the target, and at 5 or more types, follows up with Installation Art no. 3: Improvised Ribcage on Coin Ⅲ hit, once per turn.
messages.守備「展示会の主催」: 戦闘開始時に援護防御1を得て、味方が一方攻撃されるとマッ: **Defense skill — Curating the Exhibition**: Gains 1 Assist Defense at Combat Start, and when an ally is attacked one-sidedly, covers them with the clashable counter Please. Vandalism is Prohibited. The counter also counts as a skill that gains Corpus Ingredient Count.
messages.「閉場」: パッシブ「身体克服」(同期化Ⅲで取得)により、眺望(登場時21。ター: **Closing Time**: Through the passive Transcend the Corpus (unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ), when Viewing the Tableau (21 on appearing; decreases by 2 at Turn End and by 1 when a Ring ally uses a skill, the latter once per turn per Identity) reaches 0, one attack skill becomes a 5-Coin big hit on the next turn, once per battle. It takes time before it can be fired.
messages.S1「解体」・S2でマイナス効果を重ね、5種以上の敵にS2を当てて追撃を出す。生: Stack negative effects with S1 Anatomize and S2, and land S2 on enemies with 5 or more types to trigger the follow-up. Build Corpus Ingredient Count, and fire S3 at the moment its spending reaches Potency 3 to gain Tibia's Bleed infliction bonus early. Protect allies with his Defense skill's Assist Defense while cycling Count through counters. Treat Closing Time as a bonus trump card that comes sooner in long fights with more Ring allies.
